name: Jan Tonkin
title: Psychologist
description: I've been working as a therapist, teacher & supervisor in tertiary hospitals, universities & private practice since 1990. As a therapist, I seek to offer an attuned holding space for people to connect with their own innate healing capacities, supporting them to recover from past hurts and traumas in a gentle, whole hearted and supportive environment. My primary modalities these days are EMDR and attachment focused EMDR, DBR (Deep Brain Reorienting), and parts work, on a foundation of Compassion Focused Therapy and CBT.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Diverse sexualities, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), EMDR

name: Dr Robert Kaczan
title: Psychologist
description: I've completed a PhD in the area of mindfulness, stress, and well-being and am passionate about supporting adults and teens to lead more satisfying and meaningful lives. Overall, I know that the most helpful thing for people is to quickly make sense of their problems, find a concrete way forward, and regain a feeling of being in control. I use a wide range of approaches including Cognitive Behaviour Therapy (CBT), Schema Therapy, Rumination Focused Therapy, EMDR, Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), and many others, to resolve difficulties and foster resilience.

name: Megan O'Leary
title: Non-directive Pregnancy Support Psychologist
description: Megan has experience working in community mental health, hospital settings and private practice. Megan has a particular interest in working with women and has done further training in perinatal mental health.

name: Dr Raelynn Wicklein
title: Psychologist
description: RaeLynn is dedicated to work with young adults, adults, and couples. She is a Clinical & Counselling psychologist and PsyBA approved supervisor with 25+ years of experience providing clinical treatment and psychotherapy across a wide range of settings (inner urban/rural community mental health, military hospital, university counselling, child/family services, postgraduate programs, private practice) & with diverse populations (including neurodiverse, persons of CALD backgrounds and persons of the LGBTIAQ+ community).
specialties: Diverse sexualities, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Adult survivors of sexual abuse, EMDR

name: Dr Bruce Walmsley
title: Psychologist
description: Midlife and older age mental health, Australia-wide. Supporting clients to navigate change, challenge, and growth through accessible telehealth. I work with clients navigating midlife and older age depression, anxiety, grief, trauma, life transitions and questions of identity.
specialties: Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Diverse sexualities, Schema Therapy

name: Camille Baker
title: Psychologist
description: Camille is an experienced Psychologist, Gestalt therapist, Body-oriented Psychotherapist and Clinical Hypnotherapist with over 18 years of experience. She works with adolescents and adults tailoring each session to meet the unique needs of the client.

name: Beverley Marcus
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: I am a Clinical Psychologist. In my years of work, I have found that the emotional impact of a situation needs to be addressed sensitively and honestly in an environment that feels safe enough to do so. I offer EMDR In my work with individual adults, I deal with: Stress Depression Anxiety Adjustment Self-esteem Trauma Life transitions Grief and loss Relationship issues Parenting I offer perinatal counselling for: Fertility Pregnancy Birth trauma, Miscarriage Termination Pregnancy loss Transition into parenthood Postnatal depression and anxiety.
specialties: Diverse sexualities, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), EMDR
